description: This file defines the Api class within the Opencart system, providing methods for API login, token validation, session management, and cleanup in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A class managing API authentication and session handling in Opencart.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates API user with username and key, returning user info.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API session info based on a session token.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Fetches all session records for a given API ID.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes expired or old API session records for a given API ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the last modified time of a specific API session to keep it alive.

methods.name: cleanSessions
methods.description: Removes all expired API sessions from the database.
